book.name: Honowok Nair
book.title: Roh Kudus Nin Honowok Nair Lolo Hophopon Ma Nodi Yesus Lirnenihe

content: Nili ri wo'ikku leke paku ha'ar hahaa rale ri ma na'alehe haida-haida

Ri man lernohi Yesus enihe eren nammomori. Nano hi, ri Yahudi ma nodi wanakunu Yunani enihe akin kar wa'an roro ri Yahudi ma nodi wanakunu Ibrani. Hir hehel warna enu ra'ahenia, “Akilere hirira maeke walwalum enihe lernala hana'ar hanana'an, maa ainim walwalum enihe, kar lernala!”

Ri idaweli woro'o ma nodi Yesus Lirnenihe derne panaeku onne, hir polu wuku ri man lernohi Yesus na'akeme hopun. Hi ra'ahenia, “Lo'o kan wa'an mayai ma'akene hanana'an, kalo'o ainim leken kaale loikaru Makromod Lalap Lirna Wawan eni.
Ende lo'o man wa'an narehi, ai walinhe nili ri wo'ikku nano mi, ri man Roh Kudus nodi molollo, la man mori wawa'an, la ma nin honorok panaeku wa'an, leke ai mala hi tolle honowok onne,
leke huri yai hi'i lir napanak noro loikaru Makromod Lalap Lirna Wawan eni mamani.”

Ri na'akeme kokaledi hirira panaeku onne. Enpenia hir nili Stepanus, ono Roh Kudus nodi molollo ai la akin naili'il Yesus kokkoo. Enla hir nili wali'ur Pilipus, Prokhorus, Nikanor, Timon, Parmenas, noro Nikolas ma nano Antiokia. Nikolas eni ri ma ka namwali Yahudi, maa an lernohiyedi agame Yahudi me'e.
Ri man hopun enihe roro ri wo'ikku ninili enihe laa rakpali hophopon ma nodi Yesus Lirnenihe. Hir kemenala liman hi, rapanak Makromod Lalap nala molollo hi leke ilitolle honowok eni wawa'an.
Ende Makromod Lalap Lirna Wawan eni eren naderre nadaul, penia ri man lernohi Yesus eren nammomori lolo Yerusalem, la imam nammori akin naili'il Yesus haenhi.
Stepanus onne, Makromod Lalap nodi nale kokkoo, la nala molollo ai penia hi'i ha nammori ri kan dodo'onnale makun lolo heri kalarna,
maa ri namehin aile man kawale. Man kawala enihe radedem laa Yahudi rira kerei ida wekwekel, ‘Hophopon Wahwahan Ma Nahinuriyedi Me'e Rira Kerei.’
Kerei onne raramne Yahudi ma nano leke Kirene noro Aleksandaria. Hi roro ri Yahudi ma nano Kilikia noro Asia rawalha lira roro Stepanus,
maa hi ka rauroin walha Stepanus, ono Roh Kudus nala woroin ai penia nauroin wakunu wawa'an.
Ende hi rodi kalla suwsuwar rala kupan ri ida woro'o, leke hir tumdesne ai na'ahenia, “Mayai derne ri onne na'ihoru na'idaru Musa noro Makromod Lalap!”
Hi rawa'u ri namansa roro leleher lalap roro meser Horok Lap enihe, penia hir laa kele Stepanus rodi laa nakpali Yahudi rira man ho'ok kail enihe.

Hi rodi rira man kuku maka rakpali hi haenhi leke hir loikaru ha ma ka namlolo ainina hini'i wenewhe. Hi ra'ahenia, “Ri eniyeni kan ren na'ihoru na'idaru Makromod Lalap Nina Romleu man moumou dewdeweni noro idewe agame nina keneri hono'ok haenhi! Am derne an wakunkunu na'ahenia, ‘Na'amoli Yesus, ri Nazaret onne, naiye'eredi Makromod Lalap Nin Romleue, la An herre iknik honoli wenewhe na'akeme man ik upud a'ad Musa naledi maika nonolu me'e.’ ”
Hir wakunu horu, man min honopun eni po'on kakane Stepanus oin makan siksik lerlere naisedi hophopon a'am raram.

footnotes.text: ‘Hophopon wahwahan ma nahinuri’ nina panaeku ‘ri Yahudi ma nahinuriyedi nano kenern danalha de ka ramwali hophopon me'e.’
